name: Hero Motors Limited
summary: Hero Motors Limited designs, develops, makes and supplies engineered powertrain solutions to automotive OEMs in the United States, Europe, India and Southeast Asia, through Powertrain Solutions and Alloys and Metallics segments. Its products include gearboxes, e-axles and gear components, bike powertrains with CVT products and electric motors, and alloy parts such as frames, suspension forks and wheel rims.
